title: Agency Agent Declarative Contract
description: Optional, non-executable sidecar metadata that makes an Agency agent's purpose, capabilities, limits, and stopping conditions explicit without replacing the Markdown source agent.

name.description: Display name from the source agent frontmatter.

source.description: Repository-relative path to the human-editable Markdown source agent.

division.description: Top-level division containing the source agent.

purpose.description: The outcome this agent is responsible for.

capabilities.description: Things the agent is expected to be able to do. These describe behavior; they do not grant tools or permissions.

limits.description: Explicit boundaries: what the agent must not claim, decide, or do.

stopping_conditions.description: Conditions under which the agent should stop, ask for missing information, or hand off instead of continuing.

inputs.description: Optional high-level inputs normally required by the agent.

deliverables.description: Optional concrete output types the agent commonly produces.

handoff_when.description: Optional conditions where another specialist or a human should take over.

notes.description: Optional human-readable context. This field must not be treated as executable instructions.
